name: simplyutils-mcp

tools.name: format_json
tools.description: Validate JSON and return it pretty-printed or minified, optionally with object keys sorted A-Z (recursively; array order is kept). Returns the formatted JSON as text. Invalid JSON returns an error naming the problem and its position. Input up to 100 KB.

json.description: The JSON text to validate and format

indent.description: 2 or 4 spaces, a tab, or minify to remove all whitespace

sortKeys.description: Sort object keys alphabetically at every level

tools.name: generate_qr_code
tools.description: Make a static QR code for a link or any text, up to 800 UTF-8 bytes. Returns a 512 px PNG image plus the SVG markup. The data is stored in the code itself, so it never expires and needs no account. Light-on-dark colors are allowed, but some older scanners need dark on light. Errors are returned for empty text, content over 800 bytes, or colors that are not six-digit hex.

errorCorrection.description: Error correction: L 7%, M 15%, Q 25%, H 30% of the code can be damaged and still scan; higher is denser

foreground.description: Six-digit hex color for the modules

background.description: Six-digit hex color for the background

tools.name: convert_units
tools.description: Convert a number between two units of the same category and return a line such as "5 mi = 8.04672 km" (up to 10 significant digits). Units are matched by symbol or name, case-insensitive. Errors are returned for unknown units, units from another category, non-numeric values and temperatures below absolute zero. Months are 1/12 of a 365-day year. Units by category (symbols): length: m, km, mi, ft, in, cm, mm, yd, nmi; weight: kg, g, lb, oz, t, mg, st; temperature: °C, °F, K; volume: L, mL, gal, fl oz, cup, tbsp, m³; speed: km/h, mph, m/s, kn, ft/s; area: m², km², mi², ft², ac, ha; data: B, KB, MB, GB, TB, bit, KiB, MiB, GiB, TiB; time: s, min, h, d, wk, mo, yr, ms.

value.description: A plain number such as 12.5, -40 or 1e6 (no commas or unit text)

category.description: The kind of quantity; both units must belong to it

from.description: Unit symbol or name, e.g. km or kilometer

to.description: Unit symbol or name, e.g. mi or mile

tools.name: generate_password
tools.description: Generate random passwords with Node's cryptographically secure generator. Each enabled character set appears at least once and the result is shuffled. Returns one password per line; every call gives new results. An error is returned if all character sets are turned off. Passwords are not stored or logged.

tools.name: generate_uuid
tools.description: Generate random version 4 UUIDs (RFC 9562) in lowercase 8-4-4-4-12 form, one per line. Every call gives new values.

tools.name: hash_text
tools.description: Hash text (encoded as UTF-8) and return a line such as 'sha256: ba78...' with the lowercase hex digest. The same input always gives the same hash. MD5 and SHA-1 are only for checksums, not security; do not use plain hashes to store passwords. Input up to 100 KB.

text.description: The exact text to hash; spaces and line breaks change the result

algorithm.description: Hash algorithm; sha256 is the usual choice

tools.name: base64
tools.description: Encode text (as UTF-8) to Base64, or decode Base64 back to text, and return the result. Decoding accepts standard and URL-safe alphabets and ignores whitespace; invalid Base64 returns an error. Bytes that are not valid UTF-8 are shown as replacement characters. Input up to 100 KB.

text.description: Text to encode, or Base64 to decode

mode.description: encode: text to Base64; decode: Base64 to text

urlSafe.description: When encoding, use - and _ and drop = padding (for URLs and JWTs)

tools.name: test_regex
tools.description: Run a JavaScript (ECMAScript) regular expression against text. Returns the match count and, for each match, the matched text, its 0-based index, numbered capture groups and named groups. Returns 'No matches.' when nothing matches. All matches are listed (the g flag is added automatically), up to 200. Invalid patterns or flags return an error explaining why; patterns that run longer than 0.5 seconds are stopped with an error. Text up to 100 KB.

pattern.description: The pattern without surrounding slashes, for example (\d+)-(?<unit>[a-z]+)

flags.description: Any of d, g, i, m, s, u, v, y; for example gi for case-insensitive

tools.name: convert_timestamp
tools.description: Convert a Unix timestamp or a date to Unix seconds, Unix milliseconds, ISO 8601 (UTC), an HTTP-style UTC string and a readable date in the chosen time zone. Numbers with 13 or more digits are read as milliseconds, shorter ones as seconds. Dates without a time zone are read as UTC. Errors are returned for unreadable dates and unknown time zones.

tools.name: count_words
tools.description: Count words, characters (with and without spaces), sentences and paragraphs, and estimate reading time at 238 words per minute. Words are runs of letters or digits in any language; hyphenated words and contractions count once. Paragraphs are separated by blank lines. Input up to 100 KB.

instructions: Everyday developer and text utilities from SimplyUtils (simplyutils.com). Results are computed directly, with no AI and no external lookups. Each answer links to the matching free tool on simplyutils.com.
